description: This source file implements a ScoreCard class used for testing and benchmarking HTTP protocols (such as HTTP/2 and HTTP/3) by running various performance and compatibility tests including handshakes, downloads, and requests. It interacts with external servers, runs curl commands, and generates reports, primarily for assessing curl's support for different protocols.

classes.name: ScoreCardException
classes.description: Custom exception class used within ScoreCard to indicate errors specific to the scoring process.

classes.name: ScoreCard
classes.description: Main class providing methods for scoring HTTP protocols by performing various network tests, generating performance reports, and handling interaction with external HTTP servers and curl.

methods.name: ScoreCard.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the ScoreCard instance with environmental configurations and optional parameters controlling verbosity and parallel download settings.

methods.name: ScoreCard.info
methods.description: Outputs verbose informational messages to stderr if verbosity is enabled.

methods.name: ScoreCard.handshakes
methods.description: Performs sample TLS handshakes to various hosts and collects timing metrics for connection and handshake durations.

methods.name: ScoreCard._make_docs_file
methods.description: Creates a data file of specified size filled with 'x' characters for testing download functionality.

methods.name: ScoreCard._check_downloads
methods.description: Checks the results of download operations, verifying exit codes, response counts, and response codes, and reports errors if any.

methods.name: ScoreCard.transfer_single
methods.description: Performs a single download test, measuring throughput and collecting profile data.

methods.name: ScoreCard.transfer_serial
methods.description: Performs sequential download tests for a specified number of files.

methods.name: ScoreCard.transfer_parallel
methods.description: Performs parallel download tests with a configurable maximum number of concurrent connections.

methods.name: ScoreCard.download_url
methods.description: Runs different download test modes (single, serial, parallel) for a given URL and protocol and aggregates their results.

methods.name: ScoreCard.downloads
methods.description: Performs download tests for specified file sizes using different server configurations (httpd and caddy) and returns the structured results.

methods.name: ScoreCard.do_requests
methods.description: Performs multiple HTTP request tests with optional parallelism and returns performance metrics.

methods.name: ScoreCard.requests_url
methods.description: Runs request tests for a specific URL and protocol, collecting statistics.

methods.name: ScoreCard.requests
methods.description: Performs request tests across different server configurations.

methods.name: ScoreCard.score_proto
methods.description: Main entry point to score a specific protocol (h3, h2, h1), checking curl support, performing handshake, download, and request tests, and assembling a comprehensive score report.

methods.name: ScoreCard.fmt_ms
methods.description: Formats a time value in milliseconds for display.

methods.name: ScoreCard.fmt_size
methods.description: Formats a byte size into a human-readable string (B, KB, MB, GB).

methods.name: ScoreCard.fmt_mbs
methods.description: Formats throughput in MB/s for display.

methods.name: ScoreCard.fmt_reqs
methods.description: Formats request rate in requests per second.

methods.name: ScoreCard.print_score
methods.description: Outputs the final score report to stdout, including protocol details, handshake metrics, download speeds, and request stats.
